source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: every name checked against the page image; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Election of the county council, 1946, the first after the wartime postponement of the 1942 and 1945 elections: nominations received by W. Jenkinson, returning officer, 19 September 1946; contests in Armagh and Lurgan, polled 3 October 1946. The Belfast News-Letter prints no party labels, so none are given for the unopposed members. Hawthorne, Richardson, McCreesh and Mrs. Greeves were new members. Returned unopposed. C. J. Mallon: no party label printed in 1946. At other elections he stood as Nationalist (Keady, 25 May 1939, printed 'N': Armagh Guardian, 28 April 1939, p. 3 ("Labour to Oppose Nationalists: Armagh Co. Council Elections"); Keady, 5 June 1958, printed 'N.': Armagh Guardian, 23 May 1958, p. 4 ("Local Council Elections: No Contests for County Council")).
